name: canary
title: PR Canary
description: Your open PRs with one-key access to the preview URL that CI posts as a PR comment
author: liran_mizrahi

commands.name: canaries
commands.title: My PR Canaries
commands.description: List my open PRs and open their preview environment

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: urlPrefix
preferences.title: Canary URL Prefix
preferences.description: Use the newest URL in a PR comment that starts with this. Empty = the URL after a 'Canary … :' label

preferences.name: extraUrlPrefix
preferences.title: Extra Link URL Prefix
preferences.description: Optional second link from PR comments, e.g. your deploy dashboard

preferences.name: commentAuthor
preferences.title: CI Comment Author
preferences.description: Optional. GitHub login of the account that posts the preview URL, e.g. your CI bot. Only its comments are trusted. If empty, comments from bot accounts and from repository owners, members and collaborators are used.

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Optional. Use a GitHub token instead of signing in with OAuth, e.g. when your organization restricts third-party OAuth apps. Needs read access to pull requests; authorize it for SSO if required.
